data.headline: All Ages • 2-4 Hour Options!
data.description:
## Duration 

2-4 Hour Options!

#About

Enjoy one of our regularly scheduled bike tours in a more intimate setting or work with us to customize your own tour.  This is a perfect choice for families, VIPs, or anyone looking for a more personal experience on Santa Monica's  top rated bike tour!

Enjoy the best of Los Angeles with this two hour guided bike tour that begins in Santa Monica near the famous Santa Monica Pier! Take in the ocean breezes, visit the historic Venice Canals, ride through Marina del Rey, take pictures with the Art Walls, and explore Muscle Beach. The sunny California weather makes this tour a fun and beautiful experience for culture enthusiasts and history buffs. 

Choose between 2 Hours, 3 Hours, and 4 Hours four your private ride, as well as the time that you would like to go.

**Tips:**
Dress appropriately for the weather and don't forget your camera!
data.cancellation_notes:
**Tour Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your tour. 

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the tour, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid towards bike rentals that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
